comment: Moved away from Fugue's right edge the module goes inert: its controls stop having any effect and its outputs stop moving. Where a host has no expander support, MetaFugue is the same two modules on one panel. Sample and hold off leaves a rest as silence on the CV output; on, the voice holds its last note through the gap, which turns a part with holes in it into a part with long notes.
